auth.currentAccount: This browser is currently signed in as {{email}}. This is separate from the result of the new email link.
auth.otherBrowser: This link opened in a different browser from the app where you started. Return to the original app below to finish signing in.
auth.expired: This link or code has expired or was already used. Request a new email.
auth.rateLimit: Emails were requested too quickly. Wait a moment before trying again.
auth.invalidLink: Use a Skylog sign-in link: copy the email confirmation link or the recovery link from the button below.
auth.unavailable: Email sign-in is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
auth.network: Check your internet connection. Request a new email if link verification keeps failing.
auth.emailMismatch: This link belongs to a different email address. Use the email you requested from this app.
auth.requestFirst: Request a sign-in email for your own address on this screen first, then paste its link.
auth.accountChanged: Your sign-in state changed during verification. Check the current account and try again.
auth.requestLost: The original sign-in request is not available in this app. Request a new email below to sign in again.
auth.failed: Could not verify your sign-in. Check the link or code in your latest email and try again.
auth.linkSent: Tap the sign-in button in your email. If it does not connect, open ‘Trouble signing in?’ below to continue.
auth.returnAndroid: Return to the Android app where you started to finish signing in.
auth.returnWeb: Copy the recovery link and paste it under ‘Trouble signing in?’ in your original app.
auth.startAgain: Start again with a new email
auth.copied: Copied. Open ‘Trouble signing in?’ in your original app and paste it within 5 minutes.
auth.copyFailed: Could not copy. Request a new email from the original app, then press and hold its sign-in button to copy the link.
auth.pasteHelp: Paste your copied recovery link. You can also press and hold the sign-in button in the email and copy its original link. Do not share these links with anyone.
auth.freshLink: If a link was already used or is too old, request a new email. Check your spam folder if it has not arrived.
